目标仍在进行。本轮我补齐两个缺口：Gumroad/AppSumo 换路，以及**汇总一张含全部必填字段的总表**（这是目标第 3 条要求）。

[tool-call run_code] {"timeoutMs": 300000, "code": "
const cfg = { proxy: "127.0.0.1", port: 7897 };
const js = [
 "const http=require('http');",
 "const cfg=" + JSON.stringify(cfg) + ";",
 "const UA='Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/155.0.0.0 Safari/537.36';",
 "function get(u,acc){return new Promise(function(resolve,reject){",
 " const pu=new URL(u);",
 " http.get({host:cfg.proxy,port:cfg.port,path:u,headers:{Host:pu.host,'User-Agent':UA,'Accept':acc||'text/html'}},function(res){",
 " const c=[];res.on('data',function(d){c.push(d)});",
 " res.on('end',function(){resolve({status:res.statusCode, body:Buffer.concat(c).toString('utf8')})});",
 " }).on('error',reject);",
 "});}",
 "const cands=[",
 " ['gumroad_rss','https://gumroad.com/discover/rss'],",
 " ['gumroad_trending','https://gumroad.com/discover/trending'],",
 " ['indiehackers_rss','https://www.indiehackers.com/rss.xml'],",
 " ['hn_show_rss','https://hnrss.org/show?points=100'],",
 " ['hn_newest_rss','https://hnrss.org/newest?points=100&q=revenue'],",
 " ['reddit_selfhosted','https://www.reddit.com/r/selfhosted/top/.rss?t=year']",
 "];",
 "(async function(){",
 " for(const t of cands){",
 " try{",
 " const r=await get(t[1], t[0].indexOf('rss')>=0?'application/rss+xml, application/atom+xml, text/xml':'text/html');",
 " const isXml=r.body.indexOf('<rss')===0 || r.body.indexOf('<?xml')===0 || r.body.indexOf('<feed')>=0;",
 " console.log('=== '+t[0]+' -> '+r.status+' len='+r.body.length+' xml='+isXml);",
 " if(isXml){",
 " const items=(r.body.match(/<item>/g)||[]).length + (r.body.match(/<entry>/g)||[]).length;",
 " console.log(' items/entries: '+items);",
 " }",
 " }catch(e){ console.log(t[0]+' ERR '+e.message); }",
 " await new Promise(function(x){setTimeout(x,4000)});",
 " }",
 "})();",
].join("\n");
await tools.write({ file_path: "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-fill.cjs", content: js });
const f = "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-fill.cjs";
const r = await tools.pwsh({ command: "node " + JSON.stringify(f), description: "Probe additional RSS sources", timeoutMs: 260000 });
console.log(r.kind === "foreground" ? (r.stdout.text + r.stderr.text).slice(0, 5000) : JSON.stringify(r).slice(0, 2000));
", "description": "Probe Gumroad RSS, Indie Hackers RSS, HN RSS"}

const cfg = { proxy: "127.0.0.1", port: 7897 };
const js = [
  "const http=require('http');",
  "const cfg=" + JSON.stringify(cfg) + ";",
  "const UA='Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/155.0.0.0 Safari/537.36';",
  "function get(u,acc){return new Promise(function(resolve,reject){",
  "  const pu=new URL(u);",
  "  http.get({host:cfg.proxy,port:cfg.port,path:u,headers:{Host:pu.host,'User-Agent':UA,'Accept':acc||'text/html'}},function(res){",
  "    const c=[];res.on('data',function(d){c.push(d)});",
  "    res.on('end',function(){resolve({status:res.statusCode, body:Buffer.concat(c).toString('utf8')})});",
  "  }).on('error',reject);",
  "});}",
  "const cands=[",
  "  ['gumroad_rss','https://gumroad.com/discover/rss'],",
  "  ['gumroad_trending','https://gumroad.com/discover/trending'],",
  "  ['indiehackers_rss','https://www.indiehackers.com/rss.xml'],",
  "  ['hn_show_rss','https://hnrss.org/show?points=100'],",
  "  ['hn_newest_rss','https://hnrss.org/newest?points=100&q=revenue'],",
  "  ['reddit_selfhosted','https://www.reddit.com/r/selfhosted/top/.rss?t=year']",
  "];",
  "(async function(){",
  "  for(const t of cands){",
  "    try{",
  "      const r=await get(t[1], t[0].indexOf('rss')>=0?'application/rss+xml, application/atom+xml, text/xml':'text/html');",
  "      const isXml=r.body.indexOf('<rss')===0 || r.body.indexOf('<?xml')===0 || r.body.indexOf('<feed')>=0;",
  "      console.log('=== '+t[0]+' -> '+r.status+' len='+r.body.length+' xml='+isXml);",
  "      if(isXml){",
  "        const items=(r.body.match(/<item>/g)||[]).length + (r.body.match(/<entry>/g)||[]).length;",
  "        console.log('    items/entries: '+items);",
  "      }",
  "    }catch(e){ console.log(t[0]+' ERR '+e.message); }",
  "    await new Promise(function(x){setTimeout(x,4000)});",
  "  }",
  "})();",
].join("\n");
await tools.write({ file_path: "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-fill.cjs", content: js });
const f = "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-fill.cjs";
const r = await tools.pwsh({ command: "node " + JSON.stringify(f), description: "Probe additional RSS sources", timeoutMs: 260000 });
console.log(r.kind === "foreground" ? (r.stdout.text + r.stderr.text).slice(0, 5000) : JSON.stringify(r).slice(0, 2000));
